notes.title: The Detail Holiday Update
notes.notes:
With the holidays just around the corner, we thought it only right to offer our fans a bit of extra in the form of The Detail artbook and OST. Have a good one now, and don't forget to check back for Episode 2: From the Ashes next year.

Please note – The Detail Episode 1: Artbook  and Official Soundtrack will be placed in your THE DETAIL folder in the Steam Directory: ...Steam\steamapps\common\The Detail\

We also haven't forgotten to make Episode 1: Where the Dead Lie even better than before. Here's the latest update, version 1.0.4:

*Gamepad user interface overhauled
*Performance improvements
*Fixed some sounds failing to play under certain conditions
*Fixed logic issues when resuming loaded game for certain scenes
*Quick area transition on double click now works more smoothly
*Fixed glitchy audio transitions in several places
*Fixed some settings menu items displaying current state incorrectly
*Fixed incorrectly aligned speech bubbles
*Fixed bug with hotspot indicators not opening in "Arrival" scene
*Dozens of other bug fixes and other improvements
